_about: Golden cases for configuration loading and command admission (config/allowlist in both editions). Each case is a configuration document (null for the built-in defaults), the value of HOME (null when the command does not use ~), and a command; the expectation is the admission, the refusal, or the configuration error. Configuration errors name the file <config>; YAML errors are prefixed 'invalid YAML: '. Both unit-test suites load this file.

cases.name: home names a denied global option

expect.refused: global option "--exec-path" is denied for git: it can make git execute arbitrary code
subcommand "git daemon" is denied: it defines or runs arbitrary code

cases.name: home names an option denied anywhere

expect.refused: option "--upload-pack=/tmp/evil" is denied: it names a program for git to execute

cases.name: home names a denied option for another program

expect.refused: option "--upload-pack=x" is denied: it names a program for gh to execute

cases.name: home names the git config option

expect.refused: global option "-c" is denied for git: it can make git execute arbitrary code
option "--config" is denied everywhere for cargo: it can make cargo execute arbitrary code
option "-Z" is denied everywhere for cargo: it can make cargo execute arbitrary code

cases.name: home names a wrapper in the program position

expect.refused: program must be a bare command name resolved from PATH, not a path: "~"

cases.name: home names a program in the program position

expect.refused: program must be a bare command name resolved from PATH, not a path: "~"
command argument contains terminal control U+001B; control characters cannot be injected into a shared pane
